name: With prefers-color-scheme dark, the site renders in dark mode on first paint
description: With prefers-color-scheme dark, the site renders in dark mode on first paint.

planSteps.description: Set the browser/emulation to prefers-color-scheme: dark, then navigate to /
Verify the initial paint is the dark theme: the page background computed-color is a near-black from the token palette (around #131313–#222424) and body text is light, with no flash of light theme.
